subject: Walkling Court Historic Review
overview: The Medford Historical Commission reviewed site plans for 421 High Street, discussed historic documentation for the proposed Walkling Court redevelopment, and approved funding for a historic property survey on Court Street.

items.title: 421 High Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: The commission reviewed updated site plans for 421 High Street and determined no additional design comments or changes were necessary.

items.title: Walkling Court MHC Form A Review
items.summary: The board reviewed a historic resource assessment for Walkling Court and agreed to submit a letter supporting the housing authority redevelopment project while requesting photographic and historical documentation.

items.title: Certified Local Government Annual Report
items.summary: The chair reported that Medford must submit delinquent annual reports to maintain its Certified Local Government status and preserve grant funding eligibility.

items.title: Properties Under Demolition Delay and 67-69 Court Street
items.summary: The commission reviewed properties subject to demolition delay and voted to approve $500 for a Form B historical survey for 67-69 Court Street.

items.title: CPA Grant Applications and Inventory Survey Updates
items.summary: The chair updated the board on Community Preservation Act funding applications for Thomas Brooks Park and ongoing neighborhood inventory surveys in the Brickyards and Fulton Heights.

items.title: General Project and Committee Updates
items.summary: Commissioners discussed status updates on several local developments, rail trail proposals, and an outstanding marquee requirement for a former theater building.
